title: Housing, Time and Work Pressure
summary: Housing is simultaneously living space, an asset, a liability and an urban location, so it affects household costs, commuting and long-term choices. Housing and work arrangements also consume time, making time pressure and work pressure major loads in daily reality.

blocks.text: Housing is simultaneously living space, an asset, a liability and an urban location, so it affects household costs, commuting and long-term choices. Housing and work arrangements also consume time, making time pressure and work pressure major loads in daily reality.

Pressure is not measured simply by how busy one day feels. The relevant questions are whether demands persistently exceed recovery capacity, whether people retain control and exit options, and whether enough time buffer remains in ordinary life.

This article remains within the completed Book VI manuscript; B6-WEB-B does not add live current-data population. Subjective experience and structural conditions remain distinct, and no single measure is used to infer a person or an entire society.
